ocrContribution.title: Contribute samples to improve ViRead OCR
ocrContribution.enabledExplainer: The book remains in your family's private collection. When you click Stop contributing, the system stops recruiting new samples and excludes this book's samples from future dataset creation (this action does not remove samples from previously trained model checkpoints).
ocrContribution.disabledExplainer: When you enable this option, ViRead may use individual text line crop images and corresponding labels from verified pages of this book for the Stream 2 OCR training dataset (ADMIN Verified). The system does not copy the entire PDF or book to the training repository and does not share your book with other families.
ocrContribution.consentCheckbox: I confirm that I have the right to allow ViRead to use text line crop images and corresponding labels from this book for Stream 2 OCR training purposes.
ocrContribution.footerNote: Enabling or disabling this does not affect reading access or your child's progress.
ocrContribution.enabledNotice: OCR sample contribution (Stream 2) enabled for this book. Eligible pages will automatically be queued for ADMIN line-by-line verification.
